meta.name: A Bronx Tale
meta.description: Set in the Bronx during the tumultuous 1960s, an adolescent boy is torn between his honest, working-class father and a violent yet charismatic crime boss. Complicating matters is the youngster's growing attraction - forbidden in his neighborhood - for a beautiful black girl.
meta.slogan: One man lives in the neighborhood, another man owns it. A devoted father battles the local crime boss for the life of his son.
